description: Cross-market content skeleton for agents: Xiaohongshu/Douyin formulas ↔ TikTok/Reels/Substack/WeChat essay beats. Input {market?, direction?, niche?, formula_id?}. Returns original structural formulas (not scraped posts) plus bridge maps CN↔EN. Free tier ?trial=1. Costs $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (Base preferred, or Solana); no charge on errors. Free tier: pass free_trial=true (10 calls/day). Example output: {"market":"xiaohongshu","formulas":[{"id":"xhs_list","title_pattern":"N个[细分领域]推荐"}],"bridges":[{"id":"xhs_list_to_tt_ad"}]}

formula_id.description: optional single formula id e.g. xhs_list

free_trial.description: set true to use the free tier (10 calls/day) without payment

market.description: xiaohongshu | tiktok_reels | substack_essay | wechat_gongzhonghao | all (default all)

niche.description: optional filter e.g. tools, skincare, relationships

x402_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload; omit to receive payment requirements

name: format_skeleton
